_comment: Single source of truth for every colour and canvas size the renderers use. cards.py and video.py read from here; neither may hold a colour literal. VALUES ARE UNRESOLVED — see _provenance.

_provenance.note: These are the values that were hardcoded in cards.py and video.py, relocated verbatim. They have NOT been reconciled against the PursuitAI Nebula theme in apps/web/src/app/globals.css, where only 'violet' currently matches. Do not treat them as canonical until that decision is made.

size_notes.ig: 4:5 — Instagram feed, the tallest ratio IG renders without cropping
size_notes.square: 1:1 — LinkedIn square; also safe on every network
size_notes.portrait: 4:5 — LinkedIn portrait; same canvas as ig, kept as a separate name so LinkedIn sizing can move without touching Instagram
